class.name: OpenXRSpatialCapabilityConfigurationMeshTracking
class.description: Configuration header for mesh tracking. Pass this to [method OpenXRSpatialEntityExtension.create_spatial_context] to create a spatial context with mesh tracking capabilities.

method.name: add_next
method.description: This allows us to add an additional structure to our configuration such as [OpenXRSpatialContextWaterTightMeshConfig] provided they are applicable to this capability.

method.name: get_supports_mesh_3d_normals
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if we can obtain normals data for our mesh.
